sections.heading: The opportunity
paragraphs: TAMAYA Co., Ltd. (株式会社玉屋), an Osaka-based women's fashion and accessories company, is looking at international wholesale distribution of its Heartdance fashion accessories, and at possible retail store expansion partnerships outside Japan. Target markets have not been specified, so they are listed as international markets, to be confirmed.

The company is looking for partners that can place a Japanese accessory brand in front of customers: department stores, shopping mall operators, fashion retailers, wholesalers and other strategic retail partners. The opportunity is introduced through Japan Industrial Promotion Inc. (JIP Japan). Scope, territories and terms are discussed after a qualified inquiry.

sections.heading: About TAMAYA and Heartdance
paragraphs: TAMAYA began in 1937 as a women's clothing retailer and started original product planning in 2001. Its company profile describes the business as planning, manufacturing and sales of women's fashion. The head office is in Nishi-ku, Osaka, with a Kanto headquarters in Kawasaki and a Tokyo office in Shinjuku.

Heartdance is one of the company's brands, alongside Lycka, fourseasons art, blanc bleu and EPOCHGATE. The brand concept describes a Parisian-style accessory atelier with natural, calm interiors and antique-style fixtures, built around the idea that a shop should be a comfortable place to look closely at each piece. Heartdance operates a Japanese shop network in station buildings and shopping centres, an official online store, and a listing on Rakuten Fashion since May 2026.

sections.heading: Product range
paragraphs: The Heartdance site presents hair accessories as its core, including clips, hair hooks, ponytail holders and chou-chou styles, plus rings and occasion accessories. The opportunity brief also covers earrings, necklaces, bags and wider fashion accessories. The brand also runs Heartdance Petit Lapin, a children's accessory line for matching looks between parent and child.
Detailed assortments, materials and seasonal collections are not published in a form that can be quoted here and are shared with qualified buyers.

sections.heading: Expansion plans
paragraphs: The planned routes are wholesale supply of the Japanese accessory range to international buyers and, in a second step, retail store expansion with a suitable partner. Heartdance's current shop network is in Japanese cities including Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto, Nagoya, Fukuoka and Sapporo. No overseas store, existing export programme or confirmed target country is published on the official sites, so this should be read as a new international initiative.

sections.heading: Who the company wants to work with
paragraphs: Relevant partners are department stores and shopping mall operators able to offer shop-in-shop or tenant space, fashion and accessory retailers with an established customer base, and wholesalers or distributors serving boutiques. Partners with experience selling Japanese fashion or hair accessories, and with a clear view of their customers' price positioning, will find the discussion easiest.

sections.heading: Points to consider before inquiring
paragraphs: Order volumes, pricing, delivery terms, territory and any store-opening arrangement are not published and are set only after a qualified inquiry. No exclusivity or open territory should be assumed. Importers should check customs classification, product safety and labelling rules in their own market, particularly for children's accessories and items with metal components.

sections.heading: Why this is worth a conversation
paragraphs: TAMAYA is an established company with an 89-year trading history, its own design planning since 2001 and a dedicated brand shopfront in Japanese malls and station buildings. For overseas buyers it offers a Japanese hair accessory brand backed by its own retail operation rather than a trading intermediary. The international programme itself is at an early stage, which means partners can still shape the terms.
